traditional: No classical doctrine: Uranus is a modern planet unknown to traditional astrology. Read from the modern and cyclic layers; treat this contact as a slow, generational background tone.
modern: Expansion meets disruption. Attraction to unconventional ideas and systems of thought. Psychologically the opposition is inner tension to integrate: Seen as eccentric or a crank, no matter the merit of the idea. The growth is owning both sides instead of splitting them.

cyclic.meaning: Growth and disruption reach full awareness and face each other: culmination, objectivity, fulfillment or confrontation.

business: Friction in this area. Innovative thinking whose reception depends heavily on how it's framed.
shadow: Excess and overreach collides with instability for its own sake; forcing or splitting it instead of working it through.
arcApplying: A confrontation builds; the other side comes fully into view.
arcSeparating: The standoff resolves into balance or a split.

readerCopy.summary: The people celebrating rapid innovation face the communities dealing with its cost.
readerCopy.body: The people celebrating rapid innovation face the communities dealing with its cost. Jupiter opposite Uranus can put the promise of a better future directly across from higher prices, displacement, unstable work, or services that no longer fit the people who depended on the older system. Both sides may be describing the same change accurately. The question is who gets the benefit first and who is expected to adjust. Count the disruption as part of the result before expanding the model again.
